paras: My [[family|family]] prepares [[lunch|lunch]] for a new neighbour. We choose simple [[food|food]] that is easy to share.
I wash the vegetables with [[water|water]], and my brother helps me [[cut|cut]] them. Dad warms some bread.
Our neighbour arrives with her daughter. By the end of the meal, the daughter and I are already [[friend|friends]].
zh: 我的家人为新邻居准备午餐。我们选择了方便分享的简单食物。
我用水清洗蔬菜，哥哥帮我切菜。爸爸把面包加热。
邻居带着女儿来了。吃完饭时，我和她的女儿已经成了朋友。

q.s: The meal is prepared for a new neighbour.
q.why: This is stated in the first sentence.

q.s: The neighbour lives on the top floor.
